mapper.select: SELECT ARM.A_IDX AS A_IDX, ARM.A_B_IDX A_AB_IDX, ARM.A_U_IDX AS A_U_IDX, ARM.A_TYPE AS A_TYPE, ARM.A_URL AS A_URL, ARM.A_DATE AS A_DATE, ARM.A_READ AS A_READ, USR.U_NICNAME AS R_U_NAME, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, HUSR.U_NICNAME AS S_U_NAME FROM ALARM ARM JOIN USER USR ON USR.U_IDX = ARM.A_U_IDX JOIN BOARD BRD ON BRD.B_IDX = ARM.A_B_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON HRT.H_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX LEFT JOIN USER HUSR ON HUSR.U_IDX = HRT.H_U_IDX WHERE A_U_IDX = #{a_u_idx} ORDER BY A_DATE DESC
